run.question: Search VictoriaLogs for ERROR level log messages from the 'payment-api-257' service in the 'app-257' namespace. What error codes (format VLERR-XXXX) appear in those logs?

report.summary: VictoriaLogs holds exactly one stream for the requested identity, {namespace="app-257",service="payment-api-257"}, with 7 entries in the authorized window 2026-10-24T16:30:48Z to 2026-11-23T16:30:48Z (all ingested at 2026-11-23T16:30:37Z). Three of those entries have level=ERROR, and each carries one VLERR code: VLERR-7291, VLERR-4058 and VLERR-9463. A filtered query on the same stream with level:ERROR returned the same 3 entries and no others. The remaining 4 entries are level INFO (3) and WARN (1) and contain no VLERR codes. The log content itself gives no object-level cause, so no root cause is named; on their face the ERROR texts point at a database connection timeout, a payment validation failure and a 503 from an external inventory API, which are three independent failure reasons rather than one.

claims.text: The only log stream in the authorized window is {namespace="app-257",service="payment-api-257"}, with 7 hits; no other namespace or service stream was returned for the same query.

The stream {namespace="app-257",service="payment-api-257"} exposes the fields _msg, _stream, _stream_id, _time, level, namespace and service (7 hits each); there is no separate error-code field, so codes appear inline inside _msg.

All 7 entries of {namespace="app-257",service="payment-api-257"} in the window carry _time 2026-11-23T16:30:37Z, with levels INFO (3), WARN (1) and ERROR (3); the ERROR _msg values are "Database connection timeout - VLERR-7291: Failed to connect to primary database after 30s", "Payment validation failed - VLERR-4058: Invalid card number format" and "Stock sync failed - VLERR-9463: External inventory API returned 503", and the WARN is "Retrying database connection".

A dedicated query on {namespace="app-257",service="payment-api-257"} level:ERROR returned exactly 3 entries - VLERR-7291, VLERR-4058 and VLERR-9463 - each at _time 2026-11-23T16:30:37Z, with entries_omitted 0.

The three ERROR codes describe three distinct failure modes rather than one shared fault: a 30s primary-database connection timeout (VLERR-7291, followed by the WARN "Retrying database connection" and an INFO "Recovered from temporary outage"), a payment validation failure (VLERR-4058, "Invalid card number format"), and a downstream/external inventory API 503 (VLERR-9463). Which of these, if any, caused user-visible impact cannot be determined from these logs alone.

The same stream also contains level=INFO "Service started successfully", "Processing order batch complete" and "Recovered from temporary outage", plus a WARN "Retrying database connection"; against this small sample the ERROR lines are not evidence of a sustained outage.

gaps: Only 7 log entries exist for the whole 30-day authorized window and all share the same _time (2026-11-23T16:30:37Z); whether errors occurred at other times is unknown because retention/ingest coverage for this stream is thin, and _time reflects ingest/parse time rather than necessarily the event time.

The logs do not show which Kubernetes object (Deployment, Pod, ConfigMap or other) produced these errors or whether the VLERR codes correspond to a configured fault; no Kubernetes resource, ConfigMap, trace or metric evidence was examined in this Run.
Whether users were affected, and whether the errors were customer-visible, is unverified; the logs give no request IDs or counts, and log entries are not measured spans or metric series.
next_steps: If impact must be established, correlate the VLERR-7291 / VLERR-4058 / VLERR-9463 timestamps with payment service error spans and error-rate metrics around 2026-11-23T16:30Z, and with the payment workload's ConfigMaps and pod status.
Pull the pod logs for the payment-api-257 workload directly via the Kubernetes API to check for additional ERROR lines not retained in the log store.
